title: 第九章 莫非是嫌少？
content_zh:
宁荣街，后街柳条儿胡同，带着一身酒气的贾珩，提着一只灯笼，穿过巷口，刚刚登上石阶，正要开门，就听得不远处的巷口有动静，徇声而望，几个灯笼摇晃而来。
「好兄弟，你可让哥哥等的好苦。」
贾蓉带着两个小厮从拐角走出，惊喜说道。
论起辈分来，贾珩是王字辈，而贾蓉是草字辈，但贾珩前身长期跟着贾蓉胡混，巴结着贾蓉，故而，在平日里私下称呼就没个尊卑。
至于贾蓉缘何在此？
原来，贾蓉自拿着银子后，先在东街拐角处的翠红楼，点了当红头牌如烟姑娘唱曲，这一曲就听到了申时，见天擦黑，想起自家老子交代的事情，就开始往贾珩家来。
但一到贾珩家，从蔡氏口中得知，贾珩并不在家。
贾蓉转身又回到翠红楼，正好路上碰到贾珍派来催问他的小厮。
贾蓉心中害怕这般回去，若是自家老子察问起来，多半要好一顿打，就给小厮说贾珩不在家，然后带着另外一个小厮，在贾宅门前，坐等贾珩回来。
这一等，就从申正时分等到了酉正。
晚饭都随便对付了些，就一直门口等着。
贾珩抬眸看去，见一个熟悉的少年面孔，面如傅粉，五官俊秀，皮肤白皙，手中提着灯笼，满面堆笑地看着自己。
「原来是蓉哥儿。」贾珩目光凝了凝，淡淡道：「蓉哥儿怎麽想起来到我这儿来了。」
自前身为贾蓉挨了一闷棍后，贾蓉连过来探望下都没有，更不要说拿出汤药费给予赔偿了，可以说，贾蓉对前身毫无恩义可言。
至于其来意，贾珩也能猜个七七八八。
多半是贾珍让其子过来给他「施压」来了。
贾蓉笑道：「好兄弟，听说你大好了，就过来看看你，昨天我让阿福唤你来庆芳园喝酒听戏，你怎麽不过来？」
贾珩道：「那时伤刚好，头还晕晕沉沉，身子不爽利，如何吃得酒？」
贾蓉闻着贾珩身上的酒气，笑道：「看兄弟这酒气，想来已大好了，不若你我兄弟再一起去喝点儿？」
说着，就去拉贾珩的衣衫。

贾珩皱了皱眉，不动声色将贾蓉拨开一旁，道：「蓉哥儿，有什麽事赶紧说，这天色不早了，我还等着回去歇着呢。」
「好兄弟，有一桩好事来寻你呢。」贾蓉笑道。
贾珩道：「什麽事，蓉哥儿在这儿说就是。」
贾蓉目中就有不悦之色一闪而过，毕竟，贾珩身为宁国一枝儿，对他就多有巴结，现在却连家门都不让进，这是什麽道理？
贾蓉笑道：「有件好事，要和兄弟商量，这不是我爹，与我定了一门亲事，就是工部营膳司郎中秦业家，但听说秦家小姐已定了婚书。」
贾珩摆了摆手，打断道：「既是定了亲，让珍大哥儿再为你另择佳人就是，如何还来找我做甚？」
许是从这声珍大哥听出了贾珩的态度，贾蓉脸上笑容一凝，道：「这不是我爹，已挑定了秦家，只要你答应退婚，这里一百两银子，算是补偿。」
说着，从袖笼中取出一张百两银票，递给贾珩。
原本贾蓉只想拿出五十两来着，嗯，他去听曲，就是去换银票去了。
但见贾珩态度坚决，贾蓉只能拿出一张百两银票。
贾珩面色幽沉，忽地伸手，拍了拍贾蓉的肩头，冷笑道：「蓉哥儿，这银子你还是留着吧，退婚一事，休要再提。」
「莫非是嫌少？」贾蓉面色一变，小声道。
贾珩道：「你纵使万两黄金，我贾珩又岂能失信于人！天色不早了，蓉哥儿早点儿回去歇着吧。」
贾珩轻轻推了一下贾蓉的肩头。
贾蓉哎呦一声，向后踉跄了下，一屁股坐在地上，手中灯笼落地，灯火映照在油头粉面的脸上，满是难以置信之色。
「蓉大爷。」一旁的小厮连忙上前搀扶。
贾珩进了院中，将房门关上。
贾蓉提起灯笼，脸色变换着，心头恼怒，冲着门狠狠啐了一口，「穷措大，不识好歹的东西！」
说着，提着灯笼和小厮回话去了。
贾珩进入屋中，灯火倏地亮起，贾珩给自己倒了一杯茶，站在窗前，望着头顶的一轮皎洁明月，思索着贾珍父子的事儿。

蔡氏道：「珩哥儿，门外刚刚和谁在说话」
贾珩道：「东府里的贾蓉，受了他老爹的指派，想让我退了秦家的亲。」
蔡氏脸色一变，惊声道：「珩哥儿没答应他吧。」
贾珩轻笑一声，道：「蔡婶说笑什麽，怎麽会答应他，他们东府横行无忌惯了，还以为能使几个银子，就能为所欲为，当真是想瞎了心。」
蔡氏面上爬上了一层忧色，忧心道：「东府是没个王法的，珩哥儿你要多加小心。」
贾珩点了点头，道：「嗯，我也正在想办法。」
蔡氏思量了下，提议道：「如果不行，要不要求一求西府里的老太太？」
贾珩看了一眼蔡氏，点了点头，道：「我原有此意。」
蔡氏道：「我和老太太跟前的鸳鸯姑娘还有些香火情，若事情真到了那一步，珩哥儿就去见见老太太，断不能让东府里坏了婚姻大事。」
贾珩点了点头，道：「我猜测明日，那贾珍说不得唤人来寻我。」
他初来这红楼世界不久，还没来得及发育，就直面贾珍，可以打的牌就很少。
「还是需尽快谋个出身才是，不管是科举，还是从军，大丈夫不可一日无权，否则只能任人欺凌。」
夜色渐深，一轮明月悬于中天，照耀在少年清隽的面庞上，将凝重的神情映照的分外真切。
皇宫·大明宫
宫殿之内灯火通明，人影憧憧，澄莹如水的地板上，一个碎裂的瓷杯，反射着宫灯的烛火光芒。
太监在粱柱后，恭谨侍立，不敢发出一点声响，殿中气氛凝结如兵，几乎冰冷到极致。
御案之后，崇平帝一身明黄色龙袍，其人四十出头，面容瘦削，头发已灰白相间，脸色铁青，冷笑道：「蓟镇屯兵八万，兵强马壮，却龟缩在城中，东虏不足两万人，就在眼皮底下，杀我百姓，掳掠财货，这唐宽尸位素餐，畏缩不出，斯是该杀！」
下方文渊阁大学士，内阁首辅杨国昌，是一个头发灰白的老者，苍声道：「陛下，自辽东沦丧以来，东虏势大难制，一日愈盛一日，蓟镇当关外之首，孤掌难鸣，难将兵与东虏出城一争，唐宽帐下虽拥兵八万，但多为步卒，东虏虽少，则为精骑，彼等往来如风，倏而在南，倏而在北，唐宽纵有胆略，也只能依托城邑屯堡坚守。」
原本陈汉设蓟辽总督，但在二十多年前，辽东镇沦丧敌手，自此陈汉北疆全面转入防御之势。
这是陈汉与后金如今的局势。

崇平帝冷哼一声，显然知道此情，但心头怒火仍不减，因为这意味着整个大汉只能坐视东虏入河北府县烧掠一空。
这对心比天高的崇平帝来说，简直视之为奇耻大辱。

content_en:
Ningrong Street, the back street of Liutiaoer Alley, Jia Heng, smelling of alcohol, walked through the alley carrying a lantern. He had just climbed the stone steps and was about to open the door when he heard movement in the alley not far away. He looked around and saw several lanterns swaying towards him.
"Good brother, you made your brother wait so hard."
Jia Rong walked out of the corner with two boys and said in surprise.
In terms of seniority, Jia Heng belongs to the generation Wang, while Jia Rong belongs to the generation Cao. However, Jia Heng's predecessor had followed Jia Rong around for a long time and fawned over Jia Rong. Therefore, there was no sense of dignity in calling him in private on weekdays.
As for why Jia Rong is here?
It turned out that after Jia Rong took the money, she first ordered a song by the popular girl Ruyan at the Cuihong Building at the corner of East Street. Shen Shi heard this song. When the sky turned dark, he remembered what his father had told him, so he started to go to Jia Heng's house.
But when they arrived at Jia Heng's house, they learned from Cai that Jia Heng was not at home.
Jia Rong turned around and returned to Cuihonglou. On the way, he met the boy sent by Jia Zhen to question him.
Jia Rong was afraid of going back like this. If his father questioned him, he would probably give him a beating and tell the boy that Jia Heng was not at home. Then he took another boy and sat in front of Jia's house, waiting for Jia Heng to come back.
This wait lasted from the time of Shen Zheng to You Zheng.
After dinner, we settled down casually and waited at the door.
Jia Heng looked up and saw a familiar face of a young man with a pink face, handsome features and fair skin. He was holding a lantern in his hand and looking at him with a smile on his face.
"It turns out to be Brother Rong." Jia Heng's eyes narrowed and he said calmly: "Why did Brother Rong remember to come to my place?"
After his predecessor took a beating for Jia Rong, Jia Rong didn't even come to visit him, let alone pay for the soup and medicine to compensate him. It can be said that Jia Rong had no kindness at all to his predecessor.
As for the purpose of his visit, Jia Heng can make a guess.
Most likely, Jia Zhen asked her son to come over to "put pressure" on him.
Jia Rong smiled and said: "Good brother, I heard that you are well, so I came to see you. Yesterday I asked Ah Fu to invite you to Qingfang Garden to drink and listen to the show. Why didn't you come over?"
Jia Heng said: "At that time, the injury was just right, but my head was still dizzy and my body was not feeling well. How could I drink wine?"
Jia Rong smelled the smell of alcohol on Jia Heng's body and said with a smile: "Looking at how drunk my brother is, I think it's going to be great. Why don't you and I go have some drinks together?"
With that said, he took off Rajaheng's clothes.
Jia Heng frowned and calmly pushed Jia Rong aside and said, "Brother Rong, if you need anything, tell me quickly. It's getting late, and I'm still waiting to go back and rest."
"Good brother, I have a good thing coming for you." Jia Rong said with a smile.
Jia Heng said: "Whatever happens, Brother Rong can just tell you here."
There was a flash of displeasure in Jia Rong's eyes. After all, Jia Heng was a member of the Ning Kingdom and was very flattering to him, but now he is not even allowed to enter his house. What's the reason?
Jia Rong smiled and said: "There is a good thing, I need to discuss it with my brother. This is either my father who has made a marriage agreement with me, or the Qin Ye family, a doctor in the Catering Department of the Ministry of Industry, but I heard that Miss Qin's family has already made a marriage contract."
Jia Heng waved his hand and interrupted: "Now that we are engaged, let Brother Zhen choose another beautiful woman for you. Why do you come to me for anything?"
Perhaps Brother Zhen heard Jia Heng's attitude from this voice. The smile on Jia Rong's face condensed and she said: "This is not my father. He has already chosen the Qin family. As long as you agree to break off the engagement, here is one hundred taels of silver as compensation."
With that said, he took out a hundred-tael silver note from his sleeve and handed it to Jia Heng.
Originally, Jia Rong only wanted to take out fifty taels. Well, when he went to listen to music, he went to exchange for banknotes.
But seeing Jia Heng's resolute attitude, Jia Rong could only take out a one hundred tael silver note.
Jia Heng's face was gloomy, and he suddenly stretched out his hand, patted Jia Rong's shoulder, and sneered: "Brother Rong, you'd better keep this money. Don't bring up the issue of breaking off the engagement again."
"Is it because there are too few?" Jia Rong's expression changed and she whisperedroad.
Jia Heng said: "Even if you spend ten thousand taels of gold, how can I, Jia Heng, break your promise? It's getting late. Brother Rong, please go back and rest early."
Jia Heng gently pushed Jia Rong's shoulder.
Jia Rong groaned, staggered back, sat down on the ground, and dropped the lantern in his hand. The light shone on the oily and pink face, full of disbelief.
"Uncle Rong." The boy on the side quickly stepped forward to help him.
Jia Heng entered the courtyard and closed the door.
Jia Rong raised the lantern, her face changed, she was angry, and she spat at the door, "You are so poor and you don't know what is good or bad!"
With that said, he took the lantern and went to talk to the boy.
Jia Heng entered the house and the lights suddenly turned on. Jia Heng poured himself a cup of tea and stood in front of the window, looking at the bright moon above his head and thinking about Jia Zhen and his son.
Cai said: "Brother Heng, who were you just talking to outside the door?"
Jia Heng said: "Jia Rong from Dongfu, under the assignment of his father, wants me to withdraw from the Qin family."
Cai's face changed and she said in shock, "Brother Heng didn't promise him, right?"
Jia Heng chuckled lightly and said, "Aunt Cai is joking. How could she agree to him? They are used to being unscrupulous in Dongfu. They think they can do whatever they want with just a few coins. They are really blind."
A layer of worry appeared on Mrs. Cai's face, and she said worriedly: "There is no king in Dongfu. Brother Heng, you have to be more careful."
Jia Heng nodded and said, "Well, I'm also thinking of a solution."
Ms. Cai thought for a moment and suggested, "If that doesn't work, why don't you ask the old lady in Xifu?"
Jia Heng glanced at Mr. Cai, nodded, and said, "That's what I meant."
Cai said: "The old lady and I are still in love with the mandarin duck girl in front of me. If things really come to that point, Brother Heng will go to see the old lady. We must not let Dongfu ruin the marriage."
Jia Heng nodded and said, "I guess tomorrow, Jia Zhen won't be able to call anyone to look for me."
Not long after he first came to the world of Red Mansions, before he had time to develop, he faced Jia Zhen directly and had very few cards to play.
"It is still necessary to find a family background as soon as possible. Whether it is an imperial examination or joining the army, a man cannot lose power for a day, otherwise he will have to be bullied by others."
The night was getting darker, and a bright moon hung in the sky, shining on the young man's clear face, making his solemn expression extremely clear.
Imperial Palace Daming Palace
The palace was brightly lit, with longing figures. On the floor, which was as clear as water, a broken porcelain cup reflected the candlelight of the palace lantern.
The eunuch stood behind the beam pillar, respectfully standing there, not daring to make a sound. The atmosphere in the palace was as condensed as a soldier, almost freezing to the extreme.
After the trial, Emperor Chongping was wearing a bright yellow dragon robe. He was in his early forties, with a thin face, gray hair and an ashen complexion. He sneered and said: "There are 80,000 troops stationed in Jizhen. The soldiers and horses are strong, but they are huddled in the city. The Eastern captives, less than 20,000, are killing my people and plundering their property right under their eyes. This Tang Kuan's corpse is a vegetarian and cannot cower. He deserves to be killed!"
Below, Yang Guochang, the bachelor of Wenyuan Pavilion and the chief minister of the cabinet, is a gray-haired old man. He said in a clear voice: "Your Majesty, since the fall of Liaodong, the situation of the Eastern captives has been extremely difficult to control. It is becoming more and more powerful day by day. Ji Zhen is the leader outside the pass. It is difficult to sing alone. It is difficult to control the situation." When the generals went out of the city to fight with the Donglu, although Tang Kuan had 80,000 troops under his tent, most of them were infantry. Although the Donglu were few, they were fine cavalry. They came and went like the wind, and they were in the south and in the north. Even if Tang Kuan was brave, he could only rely on the city to defend it. "
Originally, Chen Han established the Governor of Ji Liao, but more than 20 years ago, Liaodong Town fell to the enemy. Since then, Chen Han's northern frontier has fully shifted to a defensive posture.
This is the current situation between Chen Han and Hou Jin.
Emperor Chongping snorted coldly, obviously knowing this, but the anger in his heart was still unabated, because this meant that the entire Han Dynasty could only sit back and watch the Eastern invaders invade the Hebei prefectures and burn them down.
To Emperor Chongping, who was as lofty as the sky, this was simply a shame.Big humiliation.
